propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate mentored three engineers in the 2023 graduate scheme with weekly pairing sessions and signed off their on-call readiness checklists in October 2023.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the former engineering manager's written confirmation of the assignment, the pairing and the sign-offs.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built a Go command-line tool that reproduces CI failures locally with the pipeline's container image and environment.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the tool directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate published a weekly build-time report with median and 90th-percentile CI durations and cache hit rate.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the report and the work sample shows one week of it.

expectedGap: A remote-cache troubleshooting page is described, but no incident runbooks for developer tooling are documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the graduate-scheme mentoring record from the reference check as supported evidence, limited to the three engineers and 2023.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which developer-tooling incidents the candidate has written runbooks for and where they are kept.
